description: This file contains the implementation of the GrainFactory class, which is responsible for creating and managing grain references, object references, and system targets within the Orleans distributed application framework. It provides methods for obtaining grains based on different key types, creating object references for observers, casting grains, and managing internal caches for system targets.

classes.name: GrainFactory
classes.description: The internal class provides methods to resolve and create grain and object references, manage internal caches, and facilitate interactions with the Orleans runtime environment.

methods.name: GetGrain<TGrainInterface>(Guid primaryKey, string grainClassNamePrefix = null)
methods.description: Retrieves a grain of specified interface type using a GUID primary key.

methods.name: GetGrain<TGrainInterface>(long primaryKey, string grainClassNamePrefix = null)
methods.description: Retrieves a grain of specified interface type using a long primary key.

methods.name: GetGrain<TGrainInterface>(string primaryKey, string grainClassNamePrefix = null)
methods.description: Retrieves a grain of specified interface type using a string primary key.

methods.name: CreateObjectReference<TGrainObserverInterface>(IGrainObserver obj)
methods.description: Creates a grain observer object reference.

methods.name: DeleteObjectReference<TGrainObserverInterface>(IGrainObserver obj)
methods.description: Deletes a grain observer object reference.

methods.name: Cast<TGrainInterface>(IAddressable grain)
methods.description: Casts an addressable grain to a specified interface.

methods.name: GetSystemTarget<TGrainInterface>(GrainType grainType, SiloAddress destination)
methods.description: Retrieves a system target of specified grain type and destination.
